newsitem.title: NIGER: China gives Niger military equipment, training.
newsitem.headline: China gives Niger military equipment, training.

text.p: China has provided Niger with jeeps and other military equipment worth between three and four billion CFA francs ($5-$6 million), military sources said.
The military materiel offered in the aid package included 65 jeeps, around 100 trucks, light and heavy weapons and 100,000 metres (yards) of cloth for fatigues.
A group of about 10 officers from the West African state will be going to China for training as part of the aid agreement. ($ = 630 CFA francs)
